title: Cash on hand
subtitle: Cash each collector is holding until they deposit it. A deposit sends everything they collected to the ERP.
positionsHint: Over-limit first. The limit is set per collector. Click a row to see which collections the cash came from.
depositsHint: A deposit is final: everything the collector held went with it to the ERP, nobody verifies it and it cannot be changed. Click a row to see what it contained.

inHand.title: Cash on hand of {{name}}
inHand.subtitle: The cash collections not yet covered by a deposit
inHand.list: Collections behind the cash on hand
inHand.more: {{n}} older collections are not listed; the total above includes them.
inHand.how: Older deposits paid off the oldest collections first, so the cash on hand is the newest collections. Since contract 1.35.0 a collection goes to the ERP only when it is deposited; each line shows where it stands. Field-system cash, not an ERP balance.

depositDetail.title: {{name}}'s deposit
depositDetail.subtitle: The cash collections this older deposit covered
depositDetail.unmatchedNote: deposit money with no collection behind it
depositDetail.rejectedEmpty: A rejected or deleted deposit covers nothing; the cash is back on hand.
depositDetail.how: A deposit pays off the oldest collections first, so this list and the cash on hand never overlap. Field-system cash, not an ERP balance.
depositDetail.subtitleFinal: Every collection this deposit handed in
depositDetail.finalNote: Final: sent to the ERP with the deposit; nobody verifies it and it cannot be changed or deleted.
depositDetail.erpTotals: Where the money stands with the ERP
depositDetail.onTheWay: On its way to the ERP (field money)
depositDetail.howFinal: Each collection is one whole ERP payment. The ERP decides the balances; these figures are field-system money until each line says it is posted.
